title: Pairwise alignment
description: Align two sequences with affine gaps and report the alignment counts.

sequence_dim.title: Sequence dimension
sequence_dim.description: Name of the sequence dimension in both sequence inputs.

position_dim.title: Position dimension
position_dim.description: Name of the position dimension in both sequence inputs.

match.title: Match score
match.description: Score added when two aligned bases are identical.

mismatch.title: Mismatch score
mismatch.description: Score added when two aligned bases differ.

gap_open.title: Gap opening penalty
gap_open.description: Cost of the first base of a gap.

gap_extend.title: Gap extension penalty
gap_extend.description: Cost of every additional base in an open gap.

mode.title: Alignment mode
mode.description: Global alignment spans both sequences; local alignment returns the best sub-alignment.

max_cells.title: Maximum matrix cells
max_cells.description: Refuse to align when the dynamic-programming matrix would exceed this many cells.
